WORKFLOW.DESC: A fully digital process in 5 steps.

STEP1.TITLE: Signup
STEP1.DESC: Create your company space and upload your legal documents: tax ID, RNE and manager ID.

STEP2.TITLE: Identity verification
STEP2.DESC: Your file is reviewed automatically and scored against identity and compliance rules.

STEP3.TITLE: Electronic invoicing
STEP3.DESC: Create invoices in a guided interface where required tax data is already framed correctly.

STEP4.TITLE: Compliance
STEP4.DESC: The invoice is converted to the official format, electronically signed, and secured with a SHA-256 fingerprint.

STEP5.TITLE: Transmission
STEP5.DESC: Direct delivery to the DGI official API with receipt acknowledgment and full traceability.

FEATURES.DESC: Six focused capabilities to issue, calculate, generate, sign, send, and track Tunisian electronic invoices in one clear workflow.

INVOICE.TITLE: Guided invoice creation
INVOICE.DESC: Build invoices in a clear screen with the right fields and an instant preview before validation.
INVOICE.DETAIL: The entry flow brings together customer data, invoice lines, payment terms, and references in one place. Teams prepare a clean invoice quickly without duplicate entry or unnecessary back-and-forth.

TAXES.TITLE: VAT, FODEC, and stamp auto-calculation
TAXES.DESC: Excl. tax, VAT, FODEC, stamp duty, and total amounts are recalculated automatically based on Tunisian settings.
TAXES.DETAIL: The calculation engine applies the tax rules relevant to Tunisian invoicing as soon as data is entered. Totals update in real time to reduce discrepancies before final issuance.

UBL.TITLE: UBL 2.1 generation
UBL.DESC: Each invoice is automatically converted into UBL 2.1 XML ready for the Tunisian e-invoicing flow.
UBL.DETAIL: The platform generates a structured UBL 2.1 document from invoice data. Output stays consistent, readable, and ready for format checks and transmission.

SIGNATURE.TITLE: Electronic signature ready
SIGNATURE.DESC: Invoices are prepared for a reliable electronic signature with integrity checks before sending.
SIGNATURE.DETAIL: Generated invoices are prepared for a coherent electronic signature workflow. Document integrity is checked before delivery so the final invoice remains usable and compliant.

TRANSMISSION.TITLE: Simplified TTN / DGI sending
TRANSMISSION.DESC: Validated invoices are prepared and sent through the selected channel with a clear transmission result.
TRANSMISSION.DETAIL: Once validated and converted, the invoice follows a structured sending flow through the chosen channel. Transmission feedback is centralized in a simple way so teams can move faster.

STATUS.TITLE: Statuses, rejections, and credit notes
STATUS.DESC: Track every invoice status, identify rejections, and restart a correction or credit note quickly.
STATUS.DETAIL: The platform centralizes invoice progress statuses and helps teams correct, cancel, or reissue a document when needed. Tracking stays focused on the full invoice lifecycle.

FAQ.TITLE: Answers to the last blockers before the decision
FAQ.DESC: Before activation, teams mainly want clarity on timing, hosting, legacy data, and how DGI rejections are handled.

OLD_INVOICES.QUESTION: What happens to my older invoices?
OLD_INVOICES.ANSWER: Your existing invoices remain accessible in your organization. TuniFlow first covers the new electronic invoicing flow, then the team can support data migration if needed.

ACTIVATION.QUESTION: How long until we are operational?
ACTIVATION.ANSWER: Activation depends on the file and readiness level, but the process is designed to move quickly. Once documents are validated, your space can usually be opened within a few business days.

CANCELLATION.QUESTION: Can we cancel easily?
CANCELLATION.ANSWER: Yes. The offer is positioned around assisted rollout without long lock-in by default. Exact terms remain detailed in the commercial proposal or contract.

HOSTING.QUESTION: Where is our data hosted?
HOSTING.ANSWER: Data is hosted in Tunisia with encryption, logging, and archiving controls designed for local fiscal constraints.

DGI_REJECTION.QUESTION: What happens if an invoice is rejected by the DGI?
DGI_REJECTION.ANSWER: The invoice keeps a clear status in the platform. Teams identify the rejection reason, correct the relevant data, and relaunch processing without losing traceability.
